use_when: Checks on a dataset are being written or reviewed, a wrong value reached a consumer with nothing catching it, or an existing check is noisy enough to be ignored.
not_for: Proving one migration did what it claimed (database-migration-verification), building or repairing the pipeline that produces the data (data-pipelines), enforcing an invariant in the schema's own design (schema-design), or interpreting what the numbers mean, or enforcing an invariant inside a live schema (data-integrity).
